Slird is an extraordinarily rare fruit of humid tropical forests, especially known in southwestern Endor. It can easily be overlooked amid the thick vegetation, and harvesting it requires accurate identification.

The fruit yields a paste that acts very quickly, within 1–2 rounds. It may deprive the victim of all sensation in one to six extremities for 1–100 days. This loss of sensation is the most severe special effect listed for Slird in RMU; the Resistance Roll determines the gravity of the poisoning.
